description: This PHP class implements a filter interpreter for the 'Today' preset filter in the SuiteCRM system. It provides methods to identify if a filter name matches 'Today' and to generate a date-based filter condition for queries, specifically returning a condition that selects records entered after the start of the current day.

classes.name: Today
classes.description: A class implementing the ByPreMadeFilterInterpreter interface to handle 'Today' filters, providing logic to check for the filter name and generate the corresponding date filter condition.

methods.name: hasByPreMadeFilter
methods.description: Checks if the given filter name matches 'Today'.

methods.name: getByPreMadeFilter
methods.description: Returns a string condition for querying records entered from the start of the current day.
